title: Talent
description: Canonical, app-owned talent record. Ingested ONCE from oggdude_merged.json `talents.items` (583 entries). Captures the display-critical core (what every consumer reads today: Name/Description/Ranked/ActivationValue + ForceTalent/Conflict), plus the talent's machine-applied effects as DATA (ruling f100-effects-census §6, f100-effects-grammar-contracts R-FEGC-1/2): `effects[]` (charbuild-common $defs/effect — a talent's effect on a character-sheet number) and `pool_mods[]` (item-common $defs/pool_mod_entry, reused verbatim — a talent's dice). Both OPTIONAL; a talent without them is display-text only. Replaces the byKey talents map in normalizeOggdude and GM refData.talents.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — Ranked: 'true'|'false'|ABSENT -> bool, default false (30/583 absent). ActivationValue (583/583) maps taPassive->passive, taIncidental->incidental, taManeuver->maneuver, taAction->action, taIncidentalOOT->incidental_out_of_turn, taActionOOT->action_out_of_turn (RAW taxonomy eote p.137, aor p.141; taActionOOT: 0 base users, 1 reSpec user — ruling f9-phase-a-activation-enum-handoff 2026-07-14). ForceTalent (147) 'true' -> force_talent. Conflict (13) -> conflict int. Source (244) OR Sources (340) -> sources[]. The stray 'Activation' field (35) is reported, not captured, pending inspection. Coded effect fields: reported per-key counts in the ingest report, deferred.

same_as.description: B-1021 (ruling release-r7-bug-burndown ADDENDUM 65/66): the same talent, the same rules, a different emitted id. Names the identity's talent id; absent means the record is its own identity. Stamped by the reSpecialized emitter from the `_same_as` section of scripts/canonical/respec_talent_equivalence.json, never authored by hand. Its ONE reader is CharResolve.resolveSheetTalents, which folds a sheet's entries of one identity into one row with their ranks summed.

ranked.description: Ranked talents may be purchased multiple times with stacking effects; ranks stack across specializations (eote p.102).

activation.description: RAW activation taxonomy: Passive (always on) or Active with the required action type; 'out of turn' marks Active talents usable on others' turns (eote p.137; aor p.141). `active`: the print says Activation: Active with no parenthetical (f100-m8-batches R-M8BG-219/225); the record follows the print.

force_talent.description: Force talent — requires Force Rating 1+ to use (OggDude ForceTalent).

conflict.description: Conflict gained when this talent is used/bought, where printed (OggDude Conflict, 13/583).

effects.description: Machine-applied effects on character-sheet numbers (R-F100-2/3/4, R-FEC-1, R-FEGC-1). Written by scripts/canonical/apply_talent_effects.py, never by hand. Read by charResolve.derivedBonusesFromTalents / computeDerived through the charbuild registry.

pool_mods.description: The talent's dice-pool modifiers, the same entry shape an item carries (R-F100-6, R-FEGC-2). Written UNRANKED; poolMods.collect scales `count` by owned ranks unless the entry pins `per_rank: false`.

told.description: F-100 M8 C5 (R-M8K-5): effects the app SHOWS and never computes — spans of this talent's own description, at their moment or on the entry. Written by scripts/canonical/apply_talent_effects.py, never by hand.

item_effects.description: F-100 M8 C7 (R-M8K-7; R-M8G-16): this talent's change to ONE owned item, projected at render by ItemResolve.applyCharacterEffects; never written into the item record.

vehicle_effects.description: SHIP YARD × F-100 M8 (ruling f100-m8-c8-signature-vehicle R-M8C8-1): what this talent does to the numbers of the holder's Signature Vehicle (R-S1RJ-5). Applied only by SWRPGVesselResolve.resolve, to the ONE holder's bonded vessel (R-S4G-6), each row recorded in `because` under the talent's name.

spend.description: F-100 THE SURFACING MISSION (card f100-surfacing-roll-options-card R-SRO-3 as amended by ADDENDUM 8 F4/F11; brief f100-surfacing-roll-options-vocab §3 V3): what the owner may BUY with the roll's results after a matching check — listed in the dice hub's ONE spend menu beside a weapon's quality activations, the talent as the row's source (D-294 L1). Read by SWRPGQualityRows.talentSpendRows (the one reader). Written per ONE rank; `repeat: 'rating'` reads the owned ranks. Never applied: the player ticks, the table applies.

target.description: F-100 THE SURFACING MISSION (card R-SRO-4 as amended by ADDENDUM 8 F5/F6/F7; brief §3 V4): the owner's choice of what a matching hit does to its TARGET (today only damage dealt as strain) — a tick BEFORE the roll in the mode-tick place, labelled from the row's shape ("Deal as strain", + a paired roll_numbers row's skill: "Deal as strain (+Medicine)", D-294 L2), echoed after the roll on the TARGET lines. Read by SWRPGQualityRows.talentTargetOffers and targetRows' talent leg.

roll_numbers.description: F-100 M8 C11 (R-M8K-16): numbers this talent changes AT A ROLL — damage beside a weapon's damage, a weapon's Critical rating, the d100 of a Critical Injury the owner suffers.

_desc_override.description: Printed-page cite recorded by scripts/canonical/apply_talent_desc_overrides.py when a RAW-verified correction replaces an oggdude import typo (e.g. superior_reflexes 'melee damage' -> 'melee defense', EotE CRB p.144). Surfaced by L1cb.4 (ruling f-eds-6-pipeline-replacements Q1).

career_skill_choice_grants.description: PLAYER-CHOSEN career skills granted by a TALENT: the player picks `count` skills from `pool` and each becomes a CAREER SKILL for the PC (it does NOT grant a rank). Ruled by `talent-choice-triage` R-TCT-1/2 and `talent-choice-persist-shape` R-TCP-1 for B-181 — Well Rounded/Well Read promised the grant in prose and carried no structure, so the choice was unmakeable and career-skill XP costs were wrong. SAME field name, shape and pool vocabulary as the specialization grant by construction, not by copy-intent (R-PFR2-3: extend, never a parallel path); validate_registries L1cb.6 pins all THREE enums (species, specialization, talent) to skills.vocab.json in both directions. THE ONE DIFFERENCE IS RANKS: a talent may be owned N times, and R-TCT-2 rules each rank grants another set, so `count` is PER RANK and the total is summed at derive-time over owned tree positions — never stored (`talent-choice-persist-shape` R-TCP-1: scaling falls out of the address, it is not persisted).

spend_row.description: A talent's SPEND row (R-SRO-3, ADDENDUM 8 F4): the quality spend_row's member names and meanings (id · req · repeat · when · cite; quality.schema.json $defs/spend_row) plus the talent's anchor (`applies_to`), its words span (the menu's text, F3 (a) at the frames ruling — no authored `effect`), and the use's `cost`/`limit` shown as tags. A row priced only in Destiny carries `cost` and no `req`.

when.description: On a successful check (hit), a failed one (miss), or either (any: "when making a … check").

req.description: The price: ANY ONE clause pays (spend_tables' OR), read unchanged by spendAfford.

repeat.description: Absent: once per check. true: as often as it is paid. "rating": up to the owned ranks (an unranked talent reads 1, as an unrated quality does). A number: up to that many.

spend_clause.description: One way to pay — a single key and how many: Advantage, Triumph, or (ADDENDUM 8 F11) a Force point from the roll's light-side pips. The dark side, Threat and Despair stay the table's (an opponent's check is not the owner's tally) — EXCEPT on the OWNER's own result (roll-options card ADDENDUM 14 F7): `de` / `th` spend a Despair / Threat the owner rolled, i.e. cancel it (Translation Error, Superhuman Reflexes, Holistic Navigation); the refusal's premise, an opponent's check, does not reach the owner's own tally. A talent spend row only (this schema's; the quality and crafting spend rows keep theirs). Written as a oneOf of single-key objects (crafting-spend's req says the same with min/maxProperties, which the pack rail lib/shared/packValidate.js does not implement).

target_row.description: A talent's TARGET row (R-SRO-4, ADDENDUM 8 F5): `damage_as` strain only, OFFERED by its `condition` (the "may" words span, the talent rows' meaning of condition — never the quality row's target_condition object).

soak.description: 5e (card f100-surfacing-roll-options-card ADDENDUM 25 F3): the strain this row deals is not reduced by soak (Pressure Point, EotE p.141). Absent = soak applies as printed (Stunning Blow, EotE p.144: "This does not ignore soak"; Stun Damage p.157). Read by SWRPGQualityRows.targetRows' talent leg, which copies it onto the pushed row; the hub's echo words it.
